name: Inbox
description: What your agents need you to decide, in one place: each question an agent asks is its own item, its options as buttons and the default it takes if you don't answer; the ones it waits on first, with toasts, a badge, the Mac's and the phone's notifications, and the ones where it went with the default already quietly, with Accept all defaults. A coding agent's session that needs you (an approval, an answer to read) is a thread there too. Reports are records, listed in the morning brief, not in the inbox; progress shows on the agent's own row. And results to review (research, a clipped page) as files in Inbox/ to settle (into Inbox/.archive/), file away, or snooze till later.
forAgents: A question for the user: `inbox.ask` (options and a default, never prose); something to read later: `inbox.add`.

toasts.label: Toasts
toasts.description: a toast for what needs you (a session asking or answering) and each new result or message, with Open

notifications.label: Mac notifications
notifications.description: the Mac's notification while the desktop app is in the background

push.label: Phone notifications
push.description: on the iPhone app's notifications (and so the watch's): by default what waits on you, an agent's session that needs you (Approve and Deny for a permission, Reply for its answer) or its report; or every new event. Sent by the machine the session runs on, so a phone several machines know rings once. Needs push set up on this machine (vau docs inbox)

dispatch.label: Voice notes go to
dispatch.description: the agent a voice note (from the watch, the phone or the app) starts with it (claude, codex, claude_personal...), in a new terminal; empty: they're only kept in the inbox

voice_audio.label: Keep voice notes' audio
voice_audio.description: a voice note's recording is kept as an attachment, embedded above what was said; off, only the words are kept

dispatch_prompt.default:
A voice note from the user, dictated on their watch, phone or computer (names and words may be misheard). It's in the inbox as `{path}`, named after its first words. What they said:

{text}

The user isn't watching. First name the note for what it's about, in a few words: `vau move "{path}" "{folder}/<Title>.md"`. Then work out what it asks for and see it through:
- Something to remember or write down: write it in the vault (vau) and tell the user in one line (vau notify, with --action-open for what to look at).
- A task (code, research, a fix): do it all the way, by the rules of where it's done (a repo's CLAUDE.md); anything outward-facing (messages, posts, purchases) or that can't be undone, don't: ask instead. End it with `vau inbox report` (a one-line TL;DR, each question for the user as a --decision with its options and the default you take, the details, screenshots of what changed: vau inbox report --help); the user's answers come back here.

Last, archive the note: `vau inbox settle "{folder}/<Title>.md"` (not by editing its status, which leaves it in the inbox).
dispatch_prompt.label: Voice note prompt
dispatch_prompt.description: what that agent is told with a voice note: {path} is the note in the inbox, {folder} its folder, {text} what was said

keep_days.label: Days to keep done events
keep_days.description: how long agents' threads and events are kept on this machine once done, under Done on the Inbox page; what's open stays until it's done

decisions.description: the decisions a file asks, each its question with its options as buttons (the default marked), or its answer: in a decision's own file, itself; in a report, the ones it asked

reply.description: a reply box under an agent's report: what's typed goes back into its session (its terminal, the session resumed while its context is cached, or a new session that reads the report), and its thread is working on it

inbox.description: what needs you: decisions waiting on your answer, agents' sessions that need you, results to review in Inbox/, what agents work on since you answered, and messages
inbox.live: agents' events on this machine and the vault's other machines (not in the vault)

events.description: how many of the agents' threads and messages to show in each list, the rest folded into Show N more (0 hides them)

results.description: how many results to review to show (0 hides them)
